nodes.label: MERGE CERTIFICATE — BUILD55
nodes.rationale: BUILD55 = BUILD54 plus the chat-53 repair/addition set, applied by patch with zero rejects and ruled by M in chat 54. The certificate exists because neither parent alone carried both sets.

nodes.label: The chat 52 / 53 fork from BUILD53
nodes.rationale: Chat 52 produced BUILD54 (genesis Register entries 1-94 prepended per Ruling 66, W-090/W-091, the Ruling 63+66 appf gate); chat 53 produced BUILD53.REPAIRED (A-list repairs plus first B-list additions per HANDOFF-6). The merge was safe because the two change-sets touch zero common BUILD53 lines and share no insertion gap.

nodes.label: Guard substitute for the unbanked guard.py
nodes.rationale: guard.py is unbanked (Ruling 63 class), so the same substitute discipline as chat 53 is used and reported: diff(BUILD54, BUILD55) must be the repair set exactly and diff(.REPAIRED, BUILD55) the genesis set exactly — 710/194 diff lines, equal to BUILD53 -> BUILD54 to the line. The substitute is declared rather than silently relied on.
